findings.description: A stale draft was committed as a real file: firmware/components/app_audio/CMakeLists.txt.new, which registers a SRCS entry "dsp_probe.c" that does not exist in the tree. It is inert today (CMake/.new), but any tooling or human that "applies" it — or a future generator that copies CMakeLists.txt.new over CMakeLists.txt — makes the app_audio component fail to configure (source file not found).
findings.evidence: firmware/components/app_audio/CMakeLists.txt.new:8-12 `idf_component_register(SRCS "app_audio.cpp" "dsp_probe.c" …)`; search for dsp_probe under firmware/components/app_audio/** matches only that file, and the real CMakeLists.txt has no such SRCS entry.
findings.failureScenario: Someone replaces CMakeLists.txt with the .new draft while chasing this link fix: CMake aborts with 'Cannot find source file dsp_probe.c', the build never starts, and the voice fix looks regressed. Nothing in the tree references or explains the file.
findings.suggestedChange: Delete the stray CMakeLists.txt.new and its nonexistent dsp_probe.c reference from the tree.
